question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party, the state apparatus, and the military through ongoing elite appointments, purges of senior generals, and promotion of loyalists ahead of the 21st Party Congress scheduled for late 2027. Recent reporting shows no active challenges to his authority, with discussions focused instead on extending his leadership into a fourth term and managing broader personnel turnover at lower levels. Trader consensus at 95% for “No” reflects the absence of credible succession mechanisms, institutional barriers to removal, and Xi’s demonstrated ability to neutralize potential rivals. Plausible shifts could still arise from an abrupt health crisis, a major economic or security failure eroding elite support, or unforeseen internal elite coordination, though such developments remain low-probability based on current evidence.
